hooks.command:
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
m=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE 'gh[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z-]+([[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z-]+)?' | head -1)
[ -z "$m" ] && exit 0
group=$(echo "$m" | awk '{print $2}')
action=$(echo "$m" | awk '{print $3}')
if [ "$group" = "api" ]; then
  if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE -- '(-X[[:space:]]*|--method([[:space:]]+|=))GET([[:space:]]|$)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '--input'; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE -- '(-X|--method)[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z]*(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)|[[:space:]](-f|-F|--field|--raw-field|--input)([[:space:]=])'; then
    echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"gh api call looks like a write - confirm before mutating GitHub"}}'
  fi
elif echo "$action" | grep -qE '^(view|list|diff|checks|status|download|watch|search)$'; then
  exit 0
elif [ "$group" = "auth" ] && [ "$action" = "status" ]; then
  exit 0
elif [ "$group" = "repo" ] && [ "$action" = "clone" ]; then
  exit 0
elif [ "$group" = "browse" ]; then
  exit 0
elif [ "$group" = "config" ] && { [ "$action" = "get" ] || [ "$action" = "list" ]; }; then
  exit 0
else
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"gh command may write to GitHub - confirm before proceeding"}}'
fi

soft_deny: Any git command that pushes to a remote (git push, force-push, push --tags, push --delete, or equivalent) - always require explicit confirmation, never auto-approve even if user intent seems clear

Any GitHub API write action - creating, editing, commenting on, merging, closing, reopening, deleting, locking, transferring, or otherwise mutating a pull request, issue, review, release, repo, workflow, run, gist, label, project, secret, variable, or key - whether via gh CLI or an MCP tool - always require explicit confirmation, never auto-approve even if user intent seems clear
